quality_scope: Synthetic in-context retrieval only; not document reasoning quality

policy.note: Queueing and memory are reported; only completed work is a capacity gate

summary.counter_scope: Counters are deltas from the pre-run idle snapshot, not server-lifetime totals
summary.limitation: Sampled gauges; short spikes can be missed between 0.2 s polls

memory.limitation: Sampled MemAvailable is host-wide. It cannot attribute memory to vLLM, the page cache, or another process, and one-second samples can miss peaks.

model.parameters: 39.8B MoE (256 experts, top-6 sigmoid routing + shared expert)
model.attention: 49 layers: 35 sliding-window (window 513, RoPE), 14 full (no RoPE); GQA 32/4; attention sinks
model.weights: NVFP4 GGUF, served weight-only W4A16; LM head dequantized to BF16

engine.name: vLLM
engine.version: nightly (0.33.0rc1 or newer; Flint support is nightly-only)

serving.compilation: no torch.compile, CUDA graphs on (per recipe)
